nodes.label: Migrating to Hosted CIPP
nodes.rationale: flow: backup self-hosted config (function app must run PowerShell 7.4 or backups corrupt), deploy hosted instance via management portal, transfer four Key Vault secrets, restore backup, optional custom domain and function offloading fixes

nodes.label: CIPP Key Vault Secrets
nodes.rationale: four secrets incl ApplicationID; Application Secret plus Refresh Token together grant unattended access to every tenant connected through CIPP-SAM, treat like passwords; deployer has management-plane only, needs an access policy (not IAM) for data-plane secret reads
